compareDisposition.rationale: No distinct two-source pairing adds more than this passage and its existing Scripture connections.

observations.body: The LORD commands the first-month raising; Moses places ark, veil, furniture, court, priestly washing, and coverings, completing the work.
observations.label: The dwelling is raised and ordered

observations.body: The dwelling is raised and ordered belongs to tablets and dwelling in the Sinai trail.
observations.label: Where this sits

observations.body: Exodus 40:1–33 supplies consequence evidence for the event’s developing sequence.
observations.label: What follows from Sinai

observations.body: The tablets and dwelling instructions develop the consequences of Sinai presence; they are not additional lines inside the Ten Words.
observations.label: Reading boundary

payload.posture: Read Exodus 40:1–33 as its own source before carrying it into the wider Sinai trail.
payload.tension: The dwelling is raised and ordered follows from Sinai while remaining distinct from the words and actions at the mountain itself.
